description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Send a support ticket to the people at Avlira. ONLY when get_help and diagnose did not solve it, a bug is suspected, money or data looks wrong, or the owner asks for a human. Never promise a response time.

contact_email.description: Best email to reach the person (optional)

details.description: What happened, what was tried, up to 4000 characters

summary.description: One plain sentence, up to 200 characters

urgency.description: normal (default) or urgent (money or data wrong, locked out)
